outcome: Risk of cesarean section due to previous cesarean section
cohort: 4685 births at University Hospital of Puerto Real (Cádiz-Spain)
finding: The risk of cesarean section due to previous cesarean section, obstructed/non-progressive labor, failed induction of labor, or fetal distress is greater in overweight and obese women compared to normal-weight women.
mod_finding: Overweight and obese women have an increased risk of cesarean section for various indications, including previous cesarean section, obstructed/non-progressive labor, failed induction of labor, and fetal distress.
